content:
Here's a translation of the Sumerian text, noting that some lines are fragmentary or difficult to translate with complete certainty:

1. From the day of creation, from the day heaven and earth were formed
2. From the night of creation, from the night heaven and earth were formed
3. From the year of creation, when the year was determined
4. When the great ones were born
5. When Inana received her divine powers
6. When Inana moved about in heaven and earth
7. When Inana [...] gave birth
8. The god of their oath was bound to their sanctuary
9. The many gods became agitated and the small gods raised a storm
10. The gods dug rivers, they piled up dust in heaps
11. The gods wailed, they set their minds
12. At that time, the extensive wisdom of the many gods existed
13. Enki in the great waters, in the pure place, no god knew its interior
14. Their resting place was not at rest, and the pure one did not shine
15. The gods were lamenting, they made a mournful song
16. For the one who lies down in distress, the resting place did not shine
17. Namma gave birth to the mother of the many gods
18. She brought the lamentations of the gods to her children
19. [...] they laid down and [...] 
20. [...] did not shine
21. [...] they rejoiced [...]

Please note that this is a scholarly translation with some interpretative elements, as Sumerian texts can be challenging to translate precisely.
